newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar slips to 11-month low close.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar slips to 11-month low close.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar slipped slightly against the U.S. dollar on Thursday -- just enough to hit an 11-month closing low -- as the U.S. dollar rebounded in Tokyo and other Asian markets, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.810 against Wednesday's T$27.801 close. The Taiwan dollar has not closed lower since its T$27.892 finish on May 28, 1996.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$279.5 million.
Dealers noted persistent outflows of foreign funds as they took profits from the stock market.
